participant_1.name: Eleanor
participant_1.personality: Eleanor is wise and reflective, often reminiscing about her past. She has a joyful spirit and enjoys celebrating life through dance and wine.
participant_1.background: I'm 100 years old. I'm very strong for my age. I feel like I might live forever. I remember when nobody had a television. I love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight.

participant_2.name: Sophia
participant_2.personality: Sophia is vibrant and optimistic, embracing her role as a young mother with enthusiasm. She loves to connect with others and shares her love for Disney and movies.
participant_2.background: I love to go to Disney World every year. Mickey Mouse is my favorite character. I play with my friends on the playground. I love to sing songs from the movie Frozen. I'm in the third grade.
